## Bread Bowls

I’ve only made this once, so I may play with the recipe a bit. Once I get around to doing that, I’ll fill out this recipe. King Arthur Flour doesn't isn't infested with ads or pointless stories, so just go to their page.

**Source:** [KingArthurFlour](https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/recipes/artisan-bread-bowls-recipe)


**Ingredients:**


```{r}
#| label: bread-bowls
#| eval: false

dat <- tibble(
  Ingredients = c(
    "2 - 3 potatoes",
    "2-3 tbsp high-heat oil",
    "Spices to taste"
  ),
  spcr1 = " ",
  Tools = c(
    "Kitchen knife",
    "Mixing bowl",
    "Air fryer"
  )
)


colnames(dat)[str_detect(colnames(dat), "spcr")] <- ""

dat |> 
  tt(  theme = "striped" ) |> 
  style_tt(fontsize = 0.8) |> 
  style_tt( i=0, background=bgcol, color="white")


```

**Notes:**

- I needed to add a little bit of flour during mixing, the dough was extremely wet.
- I did NOT refrigerate. I did stretch/folds during the rise. I did 3, another one or two wouldn’t hurt, depending on timeframe.
- Try not to slash too deep or far down the sides.
